$comment: sherpa-provider — GENERATED by scripts/generate-component-spec.mjs from its .html, .css and .ts. Regenerate it, never edit it. $extensions.sherpa is kept across regen; resync-figma.mjs owns it.
$description: the data layer, over a SUBTREE of the page.

props.name: data-keep-content
props.description: every card it draws a state on keeps its content: a bar and a banner, never an overlay. Will, TODO 59. (the rest — `provide()` gives it its sources)

slots.description: the subtree — every component in it can ask

populate.description: Its declared props by name: `label` sets data-label.

capabilities.description: read/write JS properties (filterMode, limitOptions, hideUnmatched, results, countApplied, savedMenu, saveAnyScope, switchable, sectionLabels, hideOrganiseLabels, sections, highlightOnHover, legendChips, highlightAcross, singleApply, reorderFilters, moveFilters, labelColumn, countEveryValue, headingGroup, headingHover, multiFieldColumns, showAs, axisChips, appContext, applyEvery, reach, savedFilterSets, customView, view). See $extensions.sherpa.jsProps.

callable from a view definition's state block (provide, open, prepare, recheck, close, saveView, deleteView, saveFilters, applyFilters, dismissFilters, deleteFilters, renameFilters, resetView, export, import). See $extensions.sherpa.methods.

events.name: filter-mode-change
events.description: The filters moved between the toolbars and the panel.

events.name: view-change
events.description: A View was picked, opened or saved.

events.name: reach-change
events.description: Whether the page's data can be reached changed.

methods.name: provide
methods.description: Give this subtree its sources — and its Views. Every component already asking is answered again: a Context that swaps its source swaps it for everything in it. Settles once the kept Query, or the start View, is on.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Set up a page from its DEFINITION: its source over the app's store, every filter bar drawn from its scope — the View chip, the fields it holds, what it may add — and all of it provided. The source, or undefined for a page with no data.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: A page is about to be drawn from this definition, or from none: take its filter mode NOW — the panel open or shut — so its content is never drawn twice. `open()` follows.

methods.name: recheck
methods.description: Try every source that cannot reach its store again, and ask one that may miss a writer what moved — a page's Retry, its tab shown.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Leave the page, or one still opening: its source goes, and nothing in the subtree reaches it. `next`: another page follows at once, and says whether the panel stays.

methods.name: saveView
methods.description: Save what is on screen as a View of the open page, and put it on the View chip. With a name, a NEW View — a name any View has already gets ` - Copy-001`. With none, over the reader's own View on screen; a preset is never overwritten, so that answers undefined. The saved View's id, else undefined. `stay`: keep it for later, and stay on the View on screen — the save before a Reset all on view.

methods.name: deleteView
methods.description: Delete the reader's own View — the one on screen unless named — and go to the first. A preset is never deleted.

methods.name: saveFilters
methods.description: SAVE FILTERS — every scope's filters under a name, kept with the page beside its Views. A set of the same name is saved over, so a host asks first; a page's own name gets a copy's. With none, over the reader's set last taken ("Save <name>"); none answers undefined. The set's id. Will, TODO 105, 366. Without `saveAnyScope`, ONE local scope's — `scope`, or the bar that asked to save — and nothing from the View's bar or the panel. TODO 485

methods.name: applyFilters
methods.description: ADD a saved set to a bar: a preset of the reader's, on. `from`, the local scope of the bar it goes on where the set names several. Will, TODO 605

methods.name: dismissFilters
methods.description: TAKE a saved set off its bar: its chip goes, and what it held.

methods.name: deleteFilters
methods.description: DELETE a reader's saved set, never a page's own: its chip goes, and what it held.

methods.name: renameFilters
methods.description: RENAME a reader's saved set — never a page's own. Its id follows its name, and a name another set has gains a copy's. Its new id. Will, TODO 427

methods.name: resetView
methods.description: Put the filters back as the View on screen DEFINES them: the page's first Query, then the View's, as a pick puts it on. A filter the reader added since goes. What "Reset all on view" does.

methods.name: export
methods.description: This subtree's whole state as JSON — each source's question, and the View on screen — for a link, another service or an agent.

methods.name: import
methods.description: Take a state back in, exactly: each named source's question, and its View — shown on the View chip, and known to the pick listener, so the next pick of the old View is heard. A source it does not name is left as it is.

jsProps.name: savedFilterSets
jsProps.type: { id: string; label: string; added: boolean; own: boolean }[]
